subject: MerchantCloud CPPO — merchant fee reconciliation & SKU mapping
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reeves <tom@merchantcloud.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MerchantCloud CPPO — merchant fee reconciliation & SKU mapping

Tom — thanks again for the demo yesterday. We had one ask from Channel Ops and Finance before we can finalize the CPPO: we need to reconcile the merchant fee structure you want surfaced in the private offer and confirm SKU to Redwood catalog mappings (so we can pass accurate pricing and entitlements to AWS).

Attached: MerchantCloud_fee_schedule_v1.xlsx and SKU_mapping_proposal.csv. Can you confirm: 1) which line items should be exposed on the CPPO (gross vs. net pricing), 2) any per-subscriber merchant fees we should model, and 3) the primary billing entity for PO routing?

Target: if we can get alignments and a signed PO by EOD Tue (May 11), we can request CPPO activation the same week.

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Channel GTM, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: MerchantCloud_fee_schedule_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB), SKU_mapping_proposal.csv (CSV, 6KB)

From: Tom Reeves <tom@merchantcloud.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: MarketplaceOps <ops@resellco.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MerchantCloud CPPO — merchant fee reconciliation & SKU mapping

Laura — appreciate the clear notes. Quick responses inline:

1) Expose gross list price on the CPPO; merchant fees should be captured off-invoice as a separate settlement line (MarketplaceOps will invoice Redwood monthly). We do not want net pricing shown on the AWS console to avoid confusing end-customers.

2) Per-subscriber fees: we have a $0.50/session surcharge for large-seat deployments (>100 seats). This should NOT be on the CPPO; we'll handle in settlement. Fine if you add a billing-note in the listing metadata.

3) Billing entity: MerchantCloud, Inc. — TAX ID 98-7654321. PO should be issued to finance@merchantcloud.io.

I've reviewed SKU_mapping_proposal.csv and flagged two SKUs that map to legacy entitlements — see comments in the file. We can accept the SKU names in your mapping but ask that you add the legacy alias for 3 SKUs so our internal provisioning ties through.

Attaching an annotated mapping (see comments). Happy to hop on a short call if needed.

—Tom
Tom Reeves
Head of Partnerships, MerchantCloud
Tom@merchantcloud.io
+1 303-555-0108

Attachments: SKU_mapping_proposal.csv (annotated, comments)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: MarketplaceOps <ops@resellco.com>, Tom Reeves <tom@merchantcloud.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MerchantCloud CPPO — merchant fee reconciliation & SKU mapping

Looping in MarketplaceOps to confirm settlement cadence and to capture the merchant fee flow for our accounting team. MarketplaceOps — per Tom, merchant fees will be off-invoice monthly settlement to MerchantCloud. Please confirm: 1) your preferred settlement file format, 2) whether we should reserve any entitlement flags for the legacy SKUs Tom mentioned, and 3) if you need a separate reseller_ID for CPPO payouts.

Kim — can you confirm the margin caps we previously discussed for channel partners (we quoted 18% — did we want to reserve wiggle room)? Vivek — FYI on tax entity and PO routing.

Thanks,
Ben

--- Forwarded attachment: SKU_mapping_proposal_annotated.csv (comments from MerchantCloud)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MerchantCloud CPPO — merchant fee reconciliation & SKU mapping

Agree with Ben's summary. Quick clarifications from GTM/Finance:

- Margin caps: we can keep a default reseller discount cap at 18% for the CPPO, with a reserved exception path (approval by Channel Ops + Finance) up to 22% for strategic partners. I'll document the exception flow for MarketplaceOps.
- Settlement format: MarketplaceOps, we prefer CSV monthly settlements; include invoice #, AWS subscription ID, list price, merchant fee, net settlement amount.
- Legacy alias: Laura, please add the legacy alias strings to the SKU mapping CSV so MerchantCloud can reconcile.

If MerchantCloud can send a signed PO to finance@merchantcloud.io today or tomorrow, Legal can trigger the DocuSign packet for CPPO activation. Otherwise we'll need to target next-week activation.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Channel Operations — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: fee_template_settlement.csv (template)

From: Tom Reeves <tom@merchantcloud.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: MarketplaceOps <ops@resellco.com>, finance@merchantcloud.io
Date: 2027-05-11T16:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MerchantCloud CPPO — merchant fee reconciliation & SKU mapping

Laura / team — attaching the signed PO (Signed_PO_MerchantCloud.pdf). We've added the legacy alias strings to the SKU_mapping_proposal.csv per Kimberly's note and confirmed we'll send settlement files in CSV with invoice refs.

Next steps from our side: 1) MerchantCloud sends signed PO (attached) to your finance; 2) Redwood legal sends DocuSign CPPO packet to MerchantCloud; 3) Channel Ops triggers CPPO activation request with AWS after DocuSign is complete. Please confirm when you create the DocuSign packet so we can sign same-day.

Thanks — Tom

Attachments: Signed_PO_MerchantCloud.pdf (PDF, 70KB)
